_source: Core Rulebook, Cleric: Domains (d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/cleric/domains/paizo-domains, read 2026-10-04). A druid who takes a domain through nature bond uses her druid level as her cleric level for these powers (Core Rulebook, Druid: Nature Bond).
_grammar: Each power is a document in the class `grants` vocabulary: `level` is the class level it arrives at; `pool` declares uses per day (a resources pool row: max formula, refresh), spent through `cost`; `tags` hold while the power is had, and `by_level` swaps in the rung for a higher level, the way `by_tier` does on a path; `not_yet` says, out loud, what the engine has no reader for. Validated on load by rules/domains.py:validate_powers.

powers.name: Lightning Arc
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 electricity + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The ranged touch attack itself: no engine op resolves a domain power as an attack yet, so the uses are counted on the sheet and spending one is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Speak with Animals
powers.line: Speak with animals, as the spell, for 3 + your level rounds a day.
not_yet: Spending a round: there is no op that runs a spell-like ability by rounds, so the pool is counted and the talking is the GM's.

powers.name: Animal Companion
powers.line: An animal companion from 4th level, at an effective druid level of your level - 3.
not_yet: The companion arriving at 4th: it comes at level-up, and the level-up writer belongs to another lane. rules/animal_companion.py derives its numbers at any effective druid level, the -3 included, once it has arrived.
Knowledge (nature) as a class skill (Core Rulebook text for the Animal domain): class skills are read off the class document only.

powers.name: Acid Dart
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 acid + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The ranged touch attack itself: no engine op resolves a domain power as an attack yet, so the uses are counted on the sheet and spending one is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 fire + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The ranged touch attack itself: no engine op resolves a domain power as an attack yet, so the uses are counted on the sheet and spending one is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Wooden Fist
powers.line: Fists hard as wood for 3 + Wis rounds a day: lethal, no attack of opportunity, + half your level to damage (min +1).
not_yet: Turning the fists on: a toggled power needs a `toggles` row, and those are read off a class path only (rules/leveling.py, another lane's file). The rounds are counted; the damage bonus does not land yet.

powers.name: Bramble Armor
powers.line: Thorns for your level in rounds a day: a foe striking you unarmed or without reach takes 1d6 piercing + 1 per two levels.
not_yet: The thorns striking back: there is no on-being-hit trigger to hang the damage from.

powers.name: Icicle
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 cold + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The ranged touch attack itself: no engine op resolves a domain power as an attack yet, so the uses are counted on the sheet and spending one is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Storm Burst
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 nonlethal + 1 per two levels and -2 to its attacks for a round, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The ranged touch attack and its -2 rider: no engine op resolves a domain power as an attack yet.

powers.name: Lightning Lord
powers.line: Your level in bolts a day, as call lightning, any number in one standard action.
not_yet: The bolts themselves: call lightning's damage is not resolved from a domain power yet.
